CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
October 12, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PROCLAMATION FOR TRISOMY 21 AWARENESS MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim October 2021 as Trisomy 21 Awareness Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Evelyn Acevedo.
5.1 Proclamation
5.2
RECOGNITION OF FORMER ADVISORY BODY MEMBERS - It is recommended the City Council present an appreciation plaque and tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts to Misty Cota, Jeanette Jenkins, Steve Lee, and Jim Zoellner for their years of dedicated service to the community.
5.2 Recognition of Former Advisory Body Members
5.3
INTRODUCTION OF NEW FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES - It is recommended the City Council welcome Veronica Luna, Michael Alfonso, and Kyle Duran, and present them with a $40 gift certificate to Polly's Pie Restaurant, a voucher for two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts, and two passes to Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center.
5.3 Introduction of Employees
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of September 28, 2021.
7.1 Minutes
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated October 12, 2021 in the total amount of $1,596,769.94.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING AUGUST 2021 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending August 2021.
7.3 Treasurer Report
7.4
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING AUGUST 2021 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending August 2021.
7.4 Investment Report
7.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-10, CONSTRUCTION OF LA MIRADA THEATRE PATIO CAFÉ - REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2021-10, Theatre Patio Café, to Lidderdale Enterprises, Inc. in the amount of $59,414.69 and authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City.
7.5 CIP No. 2021-10
7.6
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-06, PARKING LOT SEAL COAT FOR CITY FACILITIES – CIVIC CENTER, BEHRINGER PARK, FRONTIER PARK, VETERANS PARK, WINDERMERE PARK, NEFF PARK, CREEK PARK, GARDENHILL PARK, WILDERNESS AREA, PUBLIC WORKS WAREHOUSE, THEATRE WAREHOUSE, TRANSIT FACILITY AND 14515 ALONDRA BOULEVARD – REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2021-06, Parking Lot Seal Coat for City Facilities – Civic Center, Behringer Park, Frontier Park, Veterans Park, Windermere Park, Neff Park, Creek Park, Gardenhill Park, Wilderness Area, Public Works Warehouse, Theatre Warehouse, Transit Facility and 14515 Alondra Boulevard, to J B Bostick Company, Inc. in the amount of $205,000.00; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction support services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project construction cost.
7.6 CIP No. 2021-06

8.2
RESOLUTION NO. 21-31 APPROVING THE VACATING OF STREET EASEMENTS WITHIN THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 13520 ADELFA DRIVE - It is recommended the City Council Conduct a public hearing as prescribed by law, adopt Resolution No. 21-31 approving the vacating of street easements within the property located at 13520 Adelfa Drive, and authorize the City Clerk to submit the document for recordation in the office of the Los Angeles County Recorder.
8.2 PH - Resolution No. 21-31
